comment.body:
Thanks for the original diagnostic ZIP and for the October 7 update that the issue had stopped without a PowerToys update. A separate commenter also describes Awake and Command Palette becoming enabled, but it is not clear whether that is the same behavior as your LightSwitch report. Please confirm:
1. Whether state changes have returned on your current PowerToys version, which exact modules were affected, and the event immediately before the change.
2. If it recurs, comment /bugreport immediately after the next occurrence so maintainers can inspect a fresh report rather than relying on the older ZIP.

upstream_safety.detail: Assessment only; no upstream issue, label, assignment, or comment action was taken.
